# SetDPI — Image DPI Changer (setdpi.com)

> Free online tool that changes the DPI metadata of JPG and PNG images (and TIFF, on a dedicated page) to 300, 600 or any custom value — losslessly, because only the density tag is rewritten and the pixels are never re-encoded. It runs 100% in the browser: files are never uploaded, there is no signup, and it works offline once loaded. Batch converts up to 50 images at a time and also reports an image's current DPI. The homepage is the changer; the other pages cover checking DPI, fixed-target presets from 150 to 1200 DPI, a DPI calculator, bulk conversion, format-specific PNG / JPEG / TIFF changers, and explainers on DPI vs PPI, standard DPI settings and DPI for printing.

## The tool

- [SetDPI — Image DPI Changer](https://setdpi.com/): Drop in JPG/PNG files, set the DPI value, download — nothing leaves the browser
- [Converter](https://setdpi.com/#tool): The converter itself, with the current-DPI readout
- [Image DPI calculator](https://setdpi.com/#calculator): Convert between pixel dimensions and print size at a given DPI
- [DPI Checker](https://setdpi.com/dpi-checker/): Read-only JPEG JFIF/EXIF and PNG pHYs density checker — pixel size and print size, no rewrite
- [Convert Image to 300 DPI](https://setdpi.com/convert-image-to-300-dpi/): Same lossless changer with the target pre-filled at 300 for print shops, journals, ID photos, and Etsy printables
- [Increase Image DPI](https://setdpi.com/increase-image-dpi/): Raise a 72/96/150 tag so preflight stops rejecting the file. Increasing DPI does not add pixels
- [DPI Calculator](https://setdpi.com/dpi-calculator/): Enter pixels, inches, and DPI — the calculator finds the missing value and shows print size
- [Change Image DPI to 150](https://setdpi.com/change-dpi-to-150/): Lossless 150 DPI preset for posters, banners, and large-format printing
- [Change Image DPI to 200](https://setdpi.com/change-dpi-to-200/): Lossless 200 DPI preset for web-to-print and digital delivery
- [72 DPI to 300 DPI](https://setdpi.com/72-dpi-to-300-dpi/): Convert screen-resolution images to print-ready 300 DPI
- [Convert Image to 600 DPI](https://setdpi.com/convert-image-to-600-dpi/): Lossless 600 DPI for fine art, medical imaging, and archival
- [Convert Image to 1200 DPI](https://setdpi.com/convert-image-to-1200-dpi/): Lossless 1200 DPI for precision labels and fine-detail printing
- [Bulk Image DPI Changer](https://setdpi.com/bulk-dpi-changer/): Batch-change DPI on many JPG/PNG files and download one zip
- [PNG DPI Changer](https://setdpi.com/png-dpi-changer/): Rewrites only the PNG pHYs density chunk to set DPI — pixels, transparency and palette stay untouched
- [JPEG DPI Changer](https://setdpi.com/jpeg-dpi-changer/): Rewrites JFIF APP0 density and EXIF XResolution/YResolution to set DPI — the compressed image data is never re-encoded
- [TIFF DPI Changer](https://setdpi.com/tiff-dpi-changer/): Rewrites the TIFF XResolution, YResolution and ResolutionUnit tags to set DPI — pixel data, compression and extra pages stay untouched
- [Passport Photo DPI](https://setdpi.com/passport-photo-dpi/): Set a passport or visa photo to 300 or 600 DPI, with pixel sizes for common photo formats
- [BMP DPI Changer](https://setdpi.com/bmp-dpi-changer/): Set a bitmap's pixels-per-metre DPI fields without touching pixels
- [Image DPI for Websites](https://setdpi.com/image-dpi-for-website/): Why browsers ignore the DPI tag and what actually controls sharpness on a web page
- [300 DPI in Pixels](https://setdpi.com/300-dpi-in-pixels/): Pixel dimensions for A-series, US paper, photo, card and poster sizes at 150/300/600 DPI
- [What DPI to Scan Photos](https://setdpi.com/what-dpi-to-scan-photos/): 300 for reprints, 600 to enlarge or archive, 1200+ for film — with pixel and file sizes

## Explainers

- [How to convert an image to 300 DPI online](https://setdpi.com/#how): Step-by-step walkthrough
- [What is DPI — and why it doesn't change your pixels](https://setdpi.com/#what): What the density tag actually does
- [Print size at 300 DPI — quick reference](https://setdpi.com/#print-size): Pixel dimensions to print size table
- [Who needs a 300 DPI image?](https://setdpi.com/#who): Print shops, publishers, marketplaces, print-on-demand
- [Common DPI requirements at a glance](https://setdpi.com/#requirements): Typical required values by use case
- [Why print services reject files over one number](https://setdpi.com/#why-it-matters): The rejection most people hit
- [Changing image DPI without Photoshop](https://setdpi.com/#alternatives): Alternatives and when each makes sense
- [FAQ](https://setdpi.com/#faq): Lossless-ness, supported formats, privacy
- [DPI vs PPI](https://setdpi.com/dpi-vs-ppi/): Print dots vs screen pixels, when the mix-up is harmless, and when print/scan work needs the distinction
- [Standard DPI Settings](https://setdpi.com/standard-dpi-settings/): Reference for 72, 96, 150, 200, 300, 600, and 1200 — what each value is for and how to set it
- [DPI for Printing](https://setdpi.com/dpi-for-printing/): Decision guide by print product, plus pixels needed at 300 DPI for common sizes
- [What 300 DPI Looks Like](https://setdpi.com/what-does-300-dpi-look-like/): Why a 300 DPI file and a 72 DPI file look identical on screen, and what 300 means on paper
